name: B10-0355/2025 (PPE) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
part_text:
The European Parliament says Russia is interfering in Moldova's elections on 28 September 2025 and calls on Russia to stop and withdraw its troops from the Transnistrian region. It asks the EU to impose more sanctions, help Moldova fight illegal political funding and disinformation, and open EU membership talks with Moldova before the vote. It also welcomes EU money and support already promised to Moldova. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks the EU to act and Russia to stop interfering.
- **Who it affects:** Moldova's voters, government and media, and EU governments deciding on sanctions and membership talks.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the Commission decide whether to follow these requests before Moldova's September election.
